Lets users and tools inspect multisig and other script-hash spending conditions without manually decoding scriptSig/witness data.

result.summary: This PR adds redeemScript and witnessScript fields to transaction inputs returned by getrawtransaction (verbosity 2), getblock (verbosity 2 and 3), and the /rest/block endpoint, decoding P2SH, P2WSH, and P2SH-wrapped segwit inputs when previous-output undo data is available. It introduces GetRedeemAndWitnessScripts() in script/solver.cpp to extract the relevant script from scriptSig/witness stack given the previous output's scriptPubKey, and extends TxDocOptions/TxToUniv to surface the new fields. Extensive functional tests cover P2SH, P2WSH, P2SH-P2WSH, P2SH-P2WPKH, native P2WPKH, and P2TR script-path cases to confirm correct inclusion/omission.
result.problem: Users inspecting raw transactions or blocks currently see only the raw scriptSig/witness bytes for P2SH and P2WSH inputs, requiring manual decoding to see the actual redeem/witness script (e.g. the multisig conditions). This is motivated by issue #27391 and an older attempt in #8849, aimed at wallet auditors, multisig users, and block explorer-style consumers of the RPC/REST interface.

resolved_concerns: luke-jr's concern that an early witness-detection heuristic was unreliable, addressed by rewriting the detection logic (polespinasa, 2024-11-22).

naiyoma's finding that getrawtransaction did not populate these fields (have_undo always false there) and that redeemScript/witnessScript were mislabeled for P2SH vs P2WSH, addressed in later rewrites (2025-05-08 onward).
naiyoma's finding that non-P2SH/non-segwit inputs incorrectly got a spurious redeemScript field, fixed by returning a sentinel and excluding those cases (polespinasa, 2025-09-15).
sedited's question about whether TxToUniv's other callers (decodepsbt, gettransaction) are affected, answered: they pass no txundo so are unaffected.
sedited's request to include both redeem and witness scripts via a struct rather than status codes, implemented via the RedeemAndWitnessScripts struct.
sedited's suggestion to keep the redeem script for the P2SH-P2WPKH nested-segwit case instead of clearing it, implemented by removing the clear() call (polespinasa, 2026-09-10).

result.card: This PR adds redeemScript and witnessScript fields to getrawtransaction (verbosity 2), getblock (verbosity 2/3), and the /rest/block endpoint, decoding P2SH and P2WSH script-hash inputs (including nested segwit) using previous-output undo data. It solves a real but narrow pain point for multisig auditors and block-explorer-style consumers who currently must manually decode scriptSig/witness bytes, per issue #27391 and a prior stalled attempt in #8849. The PR has been iterated on for over a year with substantial rework driven by review from naiyoma, luke-jr, and sedited, each of whose concrete correctness issues (mislabeled fields, spurious scripts for non-segwit inputs, missed nested-segwit case) were fixed by the author. Current state is Ready for review: the author is actively responsive, with same-day fixes as recently as 2026-09-10, CI is clean, and there is Concept ACK from two members (murchandamus, sedited) with no standing objections. No dependencies block it and it unblocks nothing else.
